Chris (CEO): Quick sync 1 min51) Private GA readiness (security checklist + perf gate) 2) reduce p95 by 20% 3) target <$0.40/1k tokens. Fri readout 10am PT. Post one measurable you can move this week.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Runtime action plan: toggle continuous batching, prewarm KV cache on node start, tweak scheduler heuristics. PR #4583 opens batching knob; rolling to staging.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Staging validation command:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"latency test"}'
```

Marta (VP Product): Any model variant switches will be gated by eval suite "cornerstone-smoke". No regressions for GA.

Sam (VP Eng): Routing/runtime/cache owners: drop a 1-line update here by EOD Tue. Consolidating for Fri.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/v1.14 -> staging @ 2024-05-22T09:30Z :rocket:

Chris (CEO): Two asks: 1) measurable by EOD Tue; 2) be ready with 3-slide readout Fri (metrics, risk, blockers). Bring a short backup plan if p95 target misses.

Sam (VP Eng): Budget flag: need extra dedicated GPUs for validation; sending note to Finance.
